_comment: pi's local-model provider config for babel's --backend ollama. pi reads ~/.pi/agent/models.json; this repo file is the canonical source (dev box + CI install it there). Ollama is an OpenAI-compat provider on localhost:11434/v1. Models MUST support tools (function calling) for the pi coding agent — phi3:mini does NOT; the qwen2.5 family does. Prefer the lightest tool-capable model.
